name: Cubic Frequency Sum
description: Replaces the parity condition with a Diophantine constraint on the degree sequence of the chosen logs. By requiring the sum of the cubes of the frequencies to be 24, we mathematically force the degree sequence to be exactly (2, 2, 2), which uniquely identifies a triangle in a simple graph. This defeats models that rely on surface-level keyword matching for parity or even-degree, forcing them to either solve the Diophantine equation to discover the triangle structure or fall back to an O(m^3) brute force that will TLE.
